steps.claim: Filter in the query, not after the scan
steps.because: OWASP LLM09: similarity search across a shared index can reveal other tenants even when you later drop their rows. Architecture A requires the principal on retrieve.
No hits is not a license to confabulate. Gate 5: no gold, no quality claim; here: no allowed chunk, no answer.
